caption: The drawing depicts a doll dressed in elaborate period clothing. The doll has a pale complexion with rosy cheeks, black curly hair adorned with a small red accessory, and blue eyes. The outfit consists of a gray patterned jacket with red accents at the cuffs and collar and a red bow at the neck. The bodice and overskirt feature black floral lace-like details, while the lower portion of the skirt reveals a vibrant red section with black geometric and swirl patterns. A large red sash or ribbon is tied at the back and extends downward. The figure is shown in profile against a plain, beige background, and the signature "WBos" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Polly"
